export interface BackgroundTaskCommandRequest {
    source: Required<ActionReference>;
    subject: ActionSubject;
    command: BackgroundTaskCommand;
}

export interface BackgroundTaskCommandResult {
    role: BackgroundTaskCommand["role"];
    output: unknown;
}

export interface BackgroundTaskDecideRequest {
    source: Required<ActionReference>;
    subject: ActionSubject;
    decision: string;
    role: BackgroundTaskAnswer["role"];
    note?: string;
}

export interface BackgroundTaskDecideResult {
    role: BackgroundTaskAnswer["role"];
    output: unknown;
}

export interface BackgroundTaskRow extends BackgroundTask {
    id: string;
    source: Required<ActionReference>;
    origin: BackgroundTaskCollection["source"];
}

export interface BackgroundTasksReadResult {
    tasks: BackgroundTaskRow[];
    issues: MainlineIssue[];
}

export interface WaitingItem {
    subject: ActionSubject;
    source: "event" | "task";
    event_id?: string;
    task?: ActionSubject;
    since: string;
    open: OpenTarget | null;
}

export interface WaitingReadResult {
    items: WaitingItem[];
    counts: {
        total: number;
    };
    issues: MainlineIssue[];
}

export interface WorkLineEvent extends WorkEvent {
    id: string;
    source: Required<ActionReference>;
    origin: WorkEventCollection["source"];
    wing: "done" | "now" | "next";
    rank: number;
    line_state?: StateRingState;
    waiting: boolean;
    tasks: {
        running: number;
        waiting: number;
        refs: ActionSubject[];
    };
}

export interface WorkLineReadResult {
    events: WorkLineEvent[];
    issues: MainlineIssue[];
}

export declare const mainlineActions: {
    line: ActionDefinition<WorkEventWindow, WorkLineReadResult>;
    waiting: ActionDefinition<WorkEventWindow, WaitingReadResult>;
    place: ActionDefinition<TaskPlaceRequest, TaskPlaceResult>;
    tasks: ActionDefinition<Record<string, never>, BackgroundTasksReadResult>;
    command: ActionDefinition<BackgroundTaskCommandRequest, BackgroundTaskCommandResult>;
    open: ActionDefinition<ObjectOpenRequest, ObjectOpenResult>;
    decide: ActionDefinition<BackgroundTaskDecideRequest, BackgroundTaskDecideResult>;
};

    readonly note_invalid: "invalid";
    readonly task_not_placeable: "invalid";
    readonly relation_ambiguous: "conflict";
    readonly event_unreadable: "not_found";
    readonly owner_answer_invalid: "upstream";
